acceptanceCriteria: A test shows whether an env-prefixed or wrapper-launched interpreter host (e.g. argv env python3 -c / a non-listed evaluating program) passes the check today
Either the check refuses those shapes, or the ATR spec states the name-based limit as an explicit non-goal with the operator responsibility named
body: Found while building V1-1852 (#1157). The {operatorNote} and carryOver host checks refuse known interpreter names and code-string options element by element. A host program not on the name list that evaluates a plain argument (a wrapper script, env-prefixed interpreter, or renamed binary) is not detected. Pre-existing before V1-1852; the rendered-argv recheck (ATR-V0-133) inherits the same blind spot. Suspected, not reproduced end to end.

title: Dispatch host interpreter detection is name-based per argv element, so a host program that evaluates a plain argument passes the operatorNote/carryOver host check
